answer: Make every agent stake a refundable bond that only unlocks after its work passes independent review, like a juniper that must survive a full season before it bears fruit. A fake identity pays the same bond but earns nothing, so the cost sends a ripple across a whole farm while honest agents recover theirs. Influence then tracks locked capital, not headcount, and no swarm can reach the zenith of the leaderboard without paying the same price as everyone else.
